title: VeloxSearch registry Spec 2.0 — Fluent Bit plugin catalogue entry (fluent-bit/<version>/<kind>s/<name>.yaml)
description: One allow-listed Fluent Bit plugin and its parameters, transcribed from the Fluent Bit manual. Drives form generation for 'add filter/processor' and validates packages' bindings (R4, R6, R12). Plugins that execute code are never catalogued (docs/spec/README.md §9).

since.description: First Fluent Bit version shipping the plugin.

event_types.description: input: event types it emits. filter/processor: event types it accepts.

as_processor.description: filter: can be attached to an input as a processor (YAML). The compiler prefers that placement (guide §7).

requires.description: Host capabilities the plugin needs; shown to the operator, checked by the agent where possible.

verified.description: true once every param was checked against the plugin's own manual page.

key.description: Plugin key. A `*` segment stands for any name (`rdkafka.*`, `collector.*.scrape_interval`).

multi.description: How the plugin takes several values: not at all, one joined string, or a repeated key (YAML list).

secret.description: Credential: only bindable from a `password` field.

operator_settable.description: false = only a package's `fixed` may set it (e.g. paths outside the agent state dir for `db`).
